name: james-heinrich/getid3
input_api: getID3::analyze(local PCM WAV path); fileformat, audio sample_rate/channels/bits_per_sample
scope: RIFF/WAVE PCM16 format, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count
family_note: Own getID3 RIFF/WAVE reader; same package release and Composer lock are shared with the PHP MP3 cell.

name: mhor/php-mediainfo
input_api: MediaInfo::getInfo(local PCM WAV path); first audio track format, sampling_rate, channel_s, bit_depth
scope: PCM format, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count, 16-bit depth
family_note: Composer wrapper delegates to external MediaInfo 26.10 CLI; same release lock as the PHP MP3 cell. The 65,580-byte control satisfies the CLI read buffer.

name: buggedcom/phpvideotoolkit
input_api: PHPVideoToolkit\MediaParser::getFileInformation(local PCM WAV path); audio sample rate, channel count, codec
scope: 8 kHz mono PCM signed 16-bit WAV audio
family_note: Composer wrapper delegates to local FFmpeg 9.0.2; same release lock as the PHP MP3 cell.

name: phpmlkit/soundfile
input_api: sf_info(local PCM WAV path); sampleRate, channels, AudioFormat::Wav and SampleFormat::Pcm16
scope: WAV container, PCM16 subtype, 8 kHz mono signal
family_note: PHP FFI binding to package-distributed libsndfile 1.2.2. Same release lock as the PHP MP3 cell.

name: owen-oj/laravel-getid3
input_api: GetId3(local PCM WAV path)::extractInfo(); fileformat and audio sample_rate/channels/bits_per_sample
scope: RIFF/WAVE PCM16 format, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count
family_note: Laravel wrapper delegates to the same pinned james-heinrich/getid3 package in its shared lock; separate package path, same parser family.

name: sempia/getid3
input_api: JamesHeinrich\GetID3\GetID3::analyze(local PCM WAV path); fileformat and audio sample rate/channels/bit depth
scope: RIFF/WAVE PCM16 format, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count
family_note: Namespaced getID3 fork; distinct Composer package path and shared parser family.

name: wikimedia/getid3
input_api: JamesHeinrich\GetID3\GetID3::analyze(local PCM WAV path); fileformat and audio sample rate/channels/bit depth
scope: RIFF/WAVE PCM16 format, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count
family_note: Wikimedia fork of namespaced getID3; distinct Composer package path and shared parser lineage.

name: indiehd/audio-manipulator
input_api: MediaParser::analyze(local PCM WAV path); fileformat and audio sample rate/channels/bit depth
scope: RIFF/WAVE PCM16 format, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count
family_note: Public MediaParserInterface accepts a local file path; implementation delegates to pinned getID3.

name: audiostreamify/hvap
input_api: Processor::audio(local PCM WAV path)->analyze(); fileformat and audio sample rate/channels/bit depth
scope: RIFF/WAVE PCM16 format, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count
family_note: Audio path delegates to pinned getID3; separate Composer package path, same parser family.

name: kiwilan/php-audio
input_api: Audio::read(local PCM WAV path)->getMetadata(); data format, sample rate, channels, codec
scope: RIFF/WAVE PCM16 format, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count and PCM codec
family_note: Metadata comes from pinned getID3. Audio::isValid() is false because the control has no selected tags; header metadata still parses.

name: nicoverbruggen/mediaprobe
input_api: MediaProbe(local PCM WAV path)::getMediaInfo(); format_name, parsed duration, bit rate
scope: WAV container name, 32 ms duration, 139 kb/s container bit rate
family_note: Composer wrapper delegates to local FFprobe 9.0.2; package path over the FFmpeg parser family.

name: php-ffmpeg/php-ffmpeg
input_api: FFProbe::create()->streams(local PCM WAV path)->audios()->first(); codec, sample rate, channels, bit depth
scope: PCM16 codec, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count, 16-bit depth
family_note: Official PHP-FFMpeg wrapper invokes local FFprobe 9.0.2; not an independent decoder.

name: gemorroj/file-wav
input_api: FileWav\Wav(local PCM WAV path)->getInfo(); compression, frame rate, channels, bits, length
scope: PCM16 compression, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count, 32 ms duration
family: Gemorroj FileWav native PHP WAV parser
family_note: Dedicated WAV reader with its own header decoder; based on classAudioFile. No shared parser package in this cell.

name: soluble/mediatools
input_api: VideoInfoReader(FFProbeConfig)->getInfo(local PCM WAV path); format, duration and audio stream codec
scope: WAV container, 32 ms duration, PCM16 audio stream
family_note: VideoInfoReader handles the valid WAV control and delegates to local FFprobe 9.0.2.

name: rasuvaeff/media-converter
input_api: FfprobeMediaInfo::probe(local PCM WAV path); audio codec, duration, bit rate
scope: PCM16 audio codec, 32 ms duration, container bit rate
family_note: Typed wrapper invokes local FFprobe 9.0.2; distinct package path over shared FFmpeg family.

name: protonemedia/php-ffmpeg
input_api: FFProbe::create()->streams(local PCM WAV path)->audios()->first(); codec, sample rate, channels, bit depth
scope: PCM16 codec, 8 kHz sample rate, mono channel count, 16-bit depth
family_note: Protonemedia fork of PHP-FFMpeg, distinct source ref; local FFprobe 9.0.2 is the shared underlying parser.

name: maximal/audio-waveform
input_api: Waveform(local PCM WAV path)->getWaveformData(8); decoded mono amplitude values
scope: Mono WAV sample amplitudes decoded into positive and negative waveform values
family_note: Package invokes local SoX to decode PCM samples before constructing waveform data; not an independent WAV decoder.

name: char0n/ffmpeg-php
input_api: Movie(local PCM WAV path); audio codec, sample rate, channels, duration
scope: PCM16 audio codec, 8 kHz mono audio, rounded 30 ms duration
family_note: FFmpegPHP wrapper parses local WAV via FFprobe 9.0.2; duration rounds to hundredths.

name: uberchel/mediainfo4php
input_api: MediaInfo::Get(local PCM WAV path, false); audio codec, sample rate, channels, bit rate
scope: PCM16 audio codec, 8 kHz mono sample stream, 128 kb/s audio bit rate
family_note: MediaInfo4PHP wrapper invokes local FFmpeg 9.0.2; not the MediaInfoLib backend despite its name.

name: bpmfinder/bpm-finder
input_api: AudioFileBpmAnalyzer::analyzeFile(local rhythmic PCM WAV path); format, sample rate, channels, duration and BPM
scope: PCM16 WAV header and 120 BPM pulse train, 8 kHz mono, 4 seconds
family: BpmFinder native PHP PCM WAV decoder
family_note: Package WavAudioDecoder reads RIFF chunks and PCM samples directly; BPM analysis uses the decoded samples.
